units.source_text: 话虽如此，实则冷泉院非常宠幸这位新皇妃，爱情久而弥笃。

en.t: That said, in truth Reizei-in cherished this new consort deeply, and his love only grew stronger with time.

units.source_text: 是年七月，新皇妃怀孕，病美人更加艳丽了。

en.t: That July, the new consort became pregnant, and the delicate beauty, though often ill, grew still more radiant.

units.source_text: 可知许多青年公子纷纷追求此女，确是有道理的。

en.t: It was clear, then, that the many young noblemen who had eagerly pursued her had good reason.

units.source_text: 看到如此艳丽的人，谁能漠然无动于衷呢？

en.t: Seeing someone so radiant, who could remain indifferent and unmoved?

units.source_text: 冷泉院常常举行管弦之会，并宣召薰君也来参与。

en.t: Reizei-in often held gatherings of music, and he summoned Lord Kaoru to take part as well.

units.source_text: 因此薰君常有机会听到新皇妃的琴声。

en.t: Thus Lord Kaoru often had chances to hear the new consort play the koto.

units.source_text: 春间合着薰君与藏人少将的《梅枝》歌声而弹和琴的侍女中将，也蒙召入参加演奏。

en.t: The lady-in-waiting Chujo, who in spring had played the Japanese koto to accompany Lord Kaoru and the Chamberlain Lieutenant as they sang The Plum Branch, was also summoned in to join the performance.

units.source_text: 薰君听到她的和琴声，回思往事，不胜感慨。

en.t: Hearing her Japanese koto, Lord Kaoru thought back on the past and was overcome with emotion.
